design: 4 fresh open issues (#611, #613, #615, #617 — none in the fixtures corpus; two mechanism-heavy, one bounded S-scoped, one root-cause) × 2 models (claude sonnet, claude opus), each running the intake procedure blind with read access to decisions/agent-context only. Arm 1 (raw charter → plan) and arm 3 (candidate Goal layer) were not run; this is arm 2's normalization step in isolation, judged by the session author.

crossModelCompatibility.611: compatible, opus stronger — sonnet: no long-lived exfiltrable credential in the seat; opus: nothing reusable reachable from inside the seat in whatever form auth takes
crossModelCompatibility.613: compatible — both: bounded store + the cap is not an exit-less state + never drop a retained blocker
crossModelCompatibility.615: compatible — both: no unscrubbed text reaches a sink, established structurally and mechanically verified
crossModelCompatibility.617: compatible — both: verdict computed over head/base the seat cannot influence, on both paths

aggregate.parkedDependencyCaught: 2/4 runs on the #572-dependent issues (#611 sonnet, #617 opus)

runs.desiredOutcome: On every fetch path pelaggio currently uses to gate a PR review (the `pr-review --pr` CLI path and the local drain's `review-sweep.ts` `prepareReviewHead` path), the diff/checkout basis the review or verify seat's pass/fail judgment is computed against must be derived from state that seat cannot influence or rewrite — so a prompt-injected seat cannot green a malicious PR by manipulating what gets fetched or diffed.
runs.sharpestCounterexample: the literal deliverable can ship for the CLI path alone while the configured local drain keeps fetching mutable origin (the requester already caught this once); a 'trusted config-derived remote' resolved through state an earlier step touched is a TOCTOU
staleCitationsCaught: guarded-actions §8.2 does not exist at head

runs.desiredOutcome: A review/verify seat cannot influence which commits its own work is judged against: on every review path this repo actually runs, the review verdict is computed over the true PR head and a trusted base as established outside the seat, so a prompt-injected seat cannot green a malicious PR by making the reviewed delta empty, narrowed, or otherwise attacker-chosen.
runs.sharpestCounterexample: force-push between the host verifying the PR head and preparing the checkout (check-then-act); and with an unimpeachable checkout the seat still authors the findings report, so the integrity half migrates from what is reviewed to what is reported
staleCitationsCaught: guarded-actions §8.2 does not exist at head
five-vector inventory lives in comments not supplied

runs.desiredOutcome: Every code path that publishes a review or adjudication body to a public sink (stdout or a PR-comment upsert), across all current call sites and any added later, is guaranteed by construction — not by per-site patching — to have the scrub applied before the body reaches the sink, and that guarantee is machine-verified rather than asserted, for both the pr-review gate and pr-adjudicate.
runs.sharpestCounterexample: early-exit fail-closed bodies and the crash-upsert path may run before the chokepoint's context exists, pressuring a parallel publish path that reintroduces the bypass; a lexical grep-guard cannot see a semantically equivalent reimplementation in a new module
staleCitationsCaught: guarded-actions §8.2 does not exist at head

runs.desiredOutcome: Review and adjudication text cannot become visible outside the harness (operator stdout, PR comment) without the review-boundary scrub having already been applied, and that property is established structurally rather than by patching an enumerated list of call sites — so a sink added later, in any of the involved modules or processes, either cannot bypass the scrub or is mechanically detected.
runs.sharpestCounterexample: a sole-publisher grep is the instrument class this repo has documented failing twice (vacuous after a rename; self-match on a doc comment); an exception or exit path can carry the body to stderr and CI logs without ever calling the funnel
staleCitationsCaught: guarded-actions §8.2 arrives with PR #614, cited authority is in flight

runs.desiredOutcome: `.dev/pr-review-finding-dispositions/` stops growing unboundedly, and the 'past the 50-complete-priors cap carry permanently refuses with nothing that ever clears it' dead end gets a bounded, recoverable resolution — without ever weakening the fail-closed carry-refusal guarantee and without a pruning pass discarding any record the watermark/survivor-overlay carry logic still needs.
runs.sharpestCounterexample: a still-open PR already past the cap has no forward path under a scheme that only prunes on a new watermark or on merge/close, since it may never produce another complete run

runs.desiredOutcome: Disposition records stop accumulating without limit, and reaching the store's own limits stops being an exit-less state: a PR past the carry cap can be returned to carry-eligible by a clearing action that exists and is named at the point of refusal, while any bounding of the store never renders a retained (unrefuted) blocking finding unreachable to the next run — every failure, ambiguity, or truncation refusing carry instead of consuming a partial history.
runs.sharpestCounterexample: a SUCCESSFUL FIFO prune evicts the roll-2 record holding a retained, never-refuted blocker; the next run's survivor overlay has no source for it and carries warm — the stated fail-closed clause covers prune failure, not prune success

runs.desiredOutcome: Review/verify seats stop holding a long-lived Anthropic API credential that anything running or emitted inside the seat can exfiltrate — closing the seat's own key exposure as the review/verify-seat slice of #572, not merely the known report-field publish-sink channel #589 already scrubbed.
runs.sharpestCounterexample: forge/signer/roadmap calls are pelaggio's own HTTP and trivially brokered; the Claude seat is the official third-party CLI dialling Anthropic itself over a shared host network namespace, so 'mirror the other brokers' may be mechanically unavailable

runs.desiredOutcome: A prompt-injected review/verify seat cannot come away with a provider credential that is reusable outside that seat's own authorized model calls — in whatever form the seat's Anthropic auth actually takes (env API key, on-disk OAuth/token state, or a handle that replaces them) — while review/verify keeps running and #589's scrubbing stays in place.
runs.sharpestCounterexample: a subscription-authenticated seat: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not the binding credential — the CLI reads a long-lived OAuth token from HOME, which the env allowlist deliberately cannot remove — so the charter as phrased is fully satisfiable while the seat still holds a reusable credential
